purpose: Replace the binary relevance gate in the public TAI contour with multi-level semantic admission, bind every platform claim to a verifiable capability registry, and remove internal routing vocabulary from the reader-facing interface.

defect.observed: Refused with "Я не смог с достаточной уверенностью связать вопрос с подтверждённой темой" — a question the platform itself offers as a starter prompt.
defect.rootCause: The knowledge route treated a medium-confidence topic match as unresolved and served the clarification copy, so any question without a literal keyword hit became a refusal regardless of how clearly it belonged to the domain.
